summary: Read-only evidence map of every enforced bound on Scholar Learn generation and every public claim about limits at HEAD 869bbe1 / v0.7.0. Live bounds are exactly: an 8-consecutive-rejection breaker, a 250-action budget, a sticky stop latch cleared only by resetTransientState, and a 4-attempt lessonComplete gap cap — all in tool-controller.ts. No wall-clock bound exists: lastProgressAt/turnActive/clock/ports.now are dead, PROGRESS_STALL_MS does not exist, and the whole reviewer layer (review-layer.ts, learn-review.ts, review-runtime.ts, including its 180s REVIEW_STALL_MS / 45m REVIEW_BACKSTOP_MS) is orphaned from the runtime and reachable only from tests. Public claims of a 15-minute stall stop, 180s stall watchdog, 12-minute review deadline and 20-minute Learn work limit have no code backing.

architecture: Live Learn bound fabric is a single closure in tool-controller.ts: counters consecutiveRejections and actionCallCount, the latch variable stoppedDelivery, and the per-section prereviewRejections map. Every one of these is only ever cleared by resetTransientState(), invoked solely from Scholar commands (commands.ts:385,423,438), session start/reset (index.ts:76,265) and activateBook (runtime-coordinator.ts:480). Two entry points guard each tool action: a pre-check in executeInner (:486-495) and a post-check in evaluateResult (:470-476). No wall clock participates: clock() feeds only lastProgressAt, which is written four times and read nowhere; turnActive is read once (:492) only to gate that dead write, and endAgentTurn() (index.ts:177) exists solely to flip it. Independently, an entire second bound stack (review-layer.ts, learn-review.ts, review-runtime.ts) is fully implemented and shipped in package.json but has no runtime caller: agent execution reaches it only if something invokes reviewLearnDraft or runReviewer, and nothing outside tests does. The widget path for reviewer progress (onReviewProgress -> runtime-coordinator.loadingReview) is likewise wired but never fired.
report:
## 1. Enforced bounds today

All live bounds live in one closure inside `tool-controller.ts`. Each is cleared *only* by `resetTransientState()`.

**Consecutive-rejection breaker (8)** — `tool-controller.ts:137` `let consecutiveRejections = 0;`; increments and trips at `tool-controller.ts:470-476`:
```
470  if (tone === "retry" || tone === "error") {
471    consecutiveRejections++;
472    if (consecutiveRejections >= 8) {
473      const breakerMsg = "scholar: paused delivery after 8 consecutive rejections to prevent a runaway loop. Run /scholar learn to resume.";
474      stopDelivery(breakerMsg, ctx);
475      return toolResult(params.action, breakerMsg, { tone: "error" });
```
Reset to 0 on any non-retry/error result at `tool-controller.ts:477-480`. Trigger: the eighth consecutive tool result whose `details.tone` is `retry` or `error`.

**Action-call budget (250)** — `tool-controller.ts:138` `let actionCallCount = 0;`; checked at `tool-controller.ts:487-490`:
```
487  if (actionCallCount >= 250 && params.action !== "status") {
488    const message = "scholar: paused delivery after reaching the 250-action budget limit to prevent a runaway loop. Run /scholar learn to resume.";
489    stopDelivery(message, ctx);
490    throw new Error(message);
```
Incremented for every non-`status` action at `tool-controller.ts:496-498`.

**Stop latch (`stoppedDelivery`)** — declared `tool-controller.ts:135`; set `tool-controller.ts:146-147`;
```
146  if (stoppedDelivery) return;
147  stoppedDelivery = message;
```
enforced on every subsequent action at `tool-controller.ts:486` `if (stoppedDelivery && params.action !== "status") throw new Error(stoppedDelivery);`. The `status` action is permanently exempt (also asserted by the test at `tests/verify-scholar-simple-learn.mjs:138-139`). Cleared only at `tool-controller.ts:771`.

**`stopDelivery`** — `tool-controller.ts:145-155`. Aborts registered review controllers (`:148`), reports via `ports.onReviewOutcome` (`:149`), notifies the UI (`:150`), then aborts Pi's loop with `ctx.abort?.()` (`:154`). It is a no-op after the first call (`:146`).

**`lessonComplete` gap-rejection limit (4)** — `tool-controller.ts:78` `const MAX_PREREVIEW_REJECTIONS = 4;`; enforced at `tool-controller.ts:620-628`:
```
620  const rejected = (prereviewRejections.get(section.id) || 0) + 1;
621  prereviewRejections.set(section.id, rejected);
624  const gapMessage = `Draft saved. Repair these delivery gaps before review: ${issues.join("; ")}`;
625  if (rejected < MAX_PREREVIEW_REJECTIONS) throw new Error(`${gapMessage} (${rejected}/${MAX_PREREVIEW_REJECTIONS} completion attempts used; ...`);
626  const message = `Draft saved; lessonComplete was rejected ${rejected} times for delivery gaps. Generation stopped. ${continueHint(section)}`;
627  stopDelivery(message, ctx);
```
Trigger: `lessonCoverageIssues` non-empty on a `deferCommit` `lessonComplete` save (`tool-controller.ts:621-624` region). Reached only when `deferCommit` is true, computed at `tool-controller.ts:595-596`.

**`resetTransientState` — the sole clearing path** — `tool-controller.ts:767-783`. Clears `completedPasses` (`:769`), `prereviewRejections` (`:770`), `stoppedDelivery = undefined` (`:771`), `consecutiveRejections = 0` (`:772`), `actionCallCount = 0` (`:773`), `turnActive = false` (`:774`), `lastProgressAt = clock()` (`:775`). Callers: `commands.ts:385`, `commands.ts:423`, `commands.ts:438`, `index.ts:76` (session_start), `index.ts:265` (session_shutdown), `runtime-coordinator.ts:480` (activateBook).

**`endAgentTurn`** — `tool-controller.ts:141-143`; called from `index.ts:177` on `agent_settled`. It only sets `turnActive = false` (a dead flag — see §2). It never clears a stop (`tool-controller.ts:109` doc comment; `index.ts:176` comment).

**Per-action / network timeouts (not generation budgets)** — `ingest.ts:359` pdfinfo `timeoutMs: 20_000`; `ingest.ts:470` pdftotext `timeoutMs: 60_000`; `ingest.ts:524` pdftoppm `timeout: 60_000`; `ingest.ts:698` full-text search `timeoutMs: 120_000`; `commons-images.ts:200` `8_000`; `commons-images.ts:284` and `:302` `15_000`. These bound individual subprocess/HTTP calls only.

**Abort / cancellation path** — `loading-progress.ts:136-143` `bindSignal` attaches an `abort` listener that calls `finish("stopped", "Interrupted", token)`. Wired at `index.ts:141` (`coordinator.loading.bindSignal(ctx.signal)` in `before_agent_start`) and `runtime-coordinator.ts:375` (`this.loading.bindSignal(ctx.signal || signal)`). `loading-progress.ts:133` also finishes "stopped" immediately if the signal is already aborted.

**Non-Learn bound, for completeness** — `commands.ts:89` `const MAX_EXAM_SCOPE_PROMPTS = 3;` (exam scope re-prompt only).

**Reviewer-layer bounds that exist in code but are unreachable from Learn** — `review-runtime.ts:50` `REVIEW_STALL_MS = 180_000`; `review-runtime.ts:51` `REVIEW_BACKSTOP_MS = 45 * 60_000`; `review-runtime.ts:53-65` `DEFAULT_REVIEWER_LIMITS`; `review-runtime.ts:204` per-run timeout; `review-runtime.ts:288` and `:324` stall timers. See §2.

## 2. Dead or orphaned bound code

- **`lastProgressAt`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:140` `let lastProgressAt = clock();`. Writes at `:140`, `:479`, `:494`, `:775`. **No readers.** No comparison against it exists anywhere in the repository.
- **`clock`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:136` `const clock = () => ports.now?.() ?? Date.now();`. Its only uses are the four `lastProgressAt` writes above. **No other reader.**
- **`ports.now`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:100-101` with the doc comment `/** Injectable wall clock for the preparation budget; tests only. */`. Never passed by `index.ts` and never read except through the dead `clock`. There is **no preparation budget anywhere**.
- **`turnActive`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:139`. Writes at `:142` (`endAgentTurn`), `:493` (set true), `:774`. Read exactly once, `tool-controller.ts:492` `if (!turnActive) {`, whose body only performs the dead `lastProgressAt = clock()` assignment. So it has one reader whose effect is a no-op.
- **`passCompleted`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:132` `const passCompleted = (key) => completedPasses.has(key);`. **No readers.**
- **`markPassCompleted`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:133`. **No readers.**
- **`completedPasses`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:131`. Never queried (its only accessor `passCompleted` is unused); only mutated by `completedPasses.delete(...)` at `:608` and `completedPasses.clear()` at `:769`.
- **`reviewStops`** — declared `tool-controller.ts:127` `const reviewStops = new Set<AbortController>();`. Iterated at `:148` and `:768`, but **`.add()` is never called anywhere**, so the set is permanently empty and both abort loops are no-ops.
- **`onReviewProgress` port** — declared `tool-controller.ts:97`, wired at `index.ts:61`. **Never invoked** (no call site in `tool-controller.ts` or elsewhere). Its consumer `runtime-coordinator.ts:389-403` `loadingReview` is therefore unreachable, including the string at `runtime-coordinator.ts:396` `\`Lesson review · round ${this.loadingRound} · 12m shared deadline\``.
- **`workElapsedMs`** — `loading-progress.ts:52`. **No readers** in source or tests.
- **`stallElapsedMs`** — `loading-progress.ts:53-56`. **No readers** in source or tests.
- **`PROGRESS_STALL_MS`** — **does not exist**: zero matches repository-wide (source, docs, tests). No Learn-generation stall watchdog is declared.
- **Reviewer modules** — `review-layer.ts`, `learn-review.ts`, `review-runtime.ts` exist and are shipped (`package.json:79-83`). Nothing in the runtime imports them: `learn-review` appears only in `learn-review.ts`, `AGENTS.md:59`, `package.json:80` and tests; `review-layer` only in `review-layer.ts`, `learn-review.ts:36`, `AGENTS.md:59`, `package.json:81`, `docs/architecture.md` and tests; `review-runtime` is imported only as a **type** by `runtime-coordinator.ts:25` and `tool-controller.ts:97` (both `ReviewerProgress`), plus `learn-review.ts`, `review-layer.ts` and tests. `reviewLearnDraft` (`learn-review.ts:180`) and `runReviewer` (`review-runtime.ts:168`) have **no non-test callers**.
- **`continue` command flag** — declared `command-syntax.ts:10` `continue?: true;`, parsed at `command-syntax.ts:30-33`, emitted at `command-syntax.ts:50`. **Never consumed**: no `.continue` / `parsed.continue` access exists anywhere.

## 3. Tests that assert bounds

**`tests/verify-scholar-simple-learn.mjs:127-139` — the only live-bound test.**
```
127  await check("eight consecutive rejections still stop delivery", async () => {
129    for (let index = 1; index < 8; index++) {
130      const rejected = await h.execute({ action: "assess", outcome: "pending", kind: "conceptual" });
131      assert.equal(rejected.details.tone, "retry", `rejection ${index}: ...`);
134    assert.equal(eighth.details.tone, "error");
135    assert.match(eighth.content[0].text, /8 consecutive rejections/);
136    const blocked = await h.execute({ action: "read", startPage: 1, endPage: 1 });
137    assert.equal(blocked.details.tone, "error");
138    const status = await h.execute({ action: "status" });
139    assert.equal(status.details.action, "status", "status stays available after a delivery stop");
```
Exact match string: `/8 consecutive rejections/`. Covers: the 8-rejection breaker, the sticky latch rejecting a subsequent action, and the `status` exemption. Also `:85-93` asserts the v0.7.0 no-reviewer contract via `assert.equal(h.reviewerCalls(), 0, "no reviewer model may be called")` and `assert.match(result.content[0].text, /Full lesson saved/)`.

**Does `verify-scholar-simple-learn.mjs` cover bounds?** Yes for the 8-rejection stop and latch only. It covers **no** time bound, **no** 250-action budget, and **no** 4-attempt `lessonComplete` gap cap.

**`tests/verify-scholar-loading-progress.mjs`** — asserts widget display only: `:25-27` `/01:05 elapsed/`, `/No new activity for 01:05/`, `/Stage 1\/4/`; `:57` `/03:05 elapsed/`; `:64-68` a stale cancellation cannot stop the handed-off run; `:74` `/Stopped.*Interrupted/`; `:76` the timer freezes; `:93` `/Incomplete.*timeout/`. It never reads `stallElapsedMs` or `workElapsedMs`.

**`tests/verify-scholar-lesson-delivery.mjs:42`** — `await assert.rejects(save({lessonComplete:true}),/Compute components/);` This is the `lessonCoverageIssues` → `commitLesson` rejection path (`lesson.ts:349-350`), not the `MAX_PREREVIEW_REJECTIONS` stop message and not a bound assertion.

**Verifiers that reference the removed reviewer layer:**
- `tests/verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs` — imports the layer at `:17` (`reviewOne, reviewLearnDraft, reviewLearnQuestion, ...`) and asserts its shared deadline at `:361-388` (`options.reviewTimeoutMs = 300`; `:371` `assert(Date.now() - started < 3000, "a hung provider cannot outlive the shared deadline")`; `:373` `assert.equal(source.failure.code, "timeout")`).
- `tests/verify-scholar-review-runtime.mjs` — imports `runReviewer, ReviewerRunError, DEFAULT_REVIEWER_LIMITS` at `:12`; asserts `timeoutMs` bounds at `:274-280`, configuration rejections at `:302-304`, shared-deadline evidence at `:311-317`, clock-advanced timeouts at `:326-331`, and stalled-stream cancellation at `:356-370`.
- `tests/verify-scholar-learn-quality.mjs` — asserts reviewer-verdict and receipt contracts at `:88-114` (`parseReviewerVerdict`, `reviewGateIssues`).
- `tests/verify-scholar-reviewed-progress.mjs:38` — seeds `section.learnQuality.reviews = ["source", "teaching", "visual"].map(...)` reviewer receipts.
- `tests/verify-scholar-obsidian-exam.mjs:578-588` — asserts the layer is **not** called: `:586` `assert.equal(reviewerCalls, 0, "exam_build must not call a reviewer model")`.

**Verifiers that reference the removed stall stop:** **none.** No test file mentions a stall stop, a 15-minute limit, `PROGRESS_STALL_MS`, the 250-action budget, `MAX_PREREVIEW_REJECTIONS`, or a preparation budget.
